title.zh: Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit
title.en: Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton is making its tokenized money-market fund shares usable as collateral on Bybit for USDT or USDC trading credit lines, letting users earn yield on the underlying assets while securing trading exposure.
